synopsis: Lee Barron is the Labour MP for Corby and East Northamptonshire, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024.

history.heading: ME/CFS: Health Services
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, what steps her Department is taking to improve support for people with myalgic encephalomyelitis.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Gender Based Violence
history.questionText: To ask the Minister for Women and Equalities, what recent assessment she has made of the potential impact of perpetrators changing their name by deed poll on victims of violence against women and girls.

history.heading: National Grid: Carbon Emissions
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Transport, what steps her Department is taking to enable grid connections for decarbonising (a) road freight vehicles, (b) shipping and (c) operations at ports and inland logistics hubs.

history.heading: Cancer: Health Services

history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Silica: Health and Safety
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Work and Pensions, whether his Department is considering a ban on engineered stone to prevent workers' increased exposure to silica dust.

history.heading: Business: Regulation
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Business and Trade, when his Department will publish the outcome of its Responsible Business Conduct Review.

history.heading: Housing: Bricks
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Housing, Communities and Local Government, whether his Department will release guidance on Swift Bricks for new build properties.

history.heading: British Nationals Abroad: United Arab Emirates
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for the Home Department, how many British citizens resident in the UAE have returned to the UK since the beginning of the war on Iran.

history.heading: Eggs: Ukraine
history.questionText: To ask the Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, what assessment her Department has made of the potential impact of the temporary removal of tariffs on egg imports from Ukraine on UK egg producers.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
